reason: Fresh successor audit after Product surface authority closure #428 proves the pinned Graphiti/Neo4j runtime, Graphiti episode/search seam, provenance-bound relationship fact projection and idempotent storage already exist, but backend/services/relationshipProjectionAuthority.js still falls back to legacy_projection and locally synthesizes relationship stage, momentum, risk, opportunity and next-action claims through ruleProjection(), exposing social_rule_projection/message_baseline as Product relationship inference. Executable root-cause governance also still requires social_rule_projection as readiness evidence. This work package retires that second inference authority at the consumer projection boundary, preserves explicit user annotations, preserves Graphiti epistemic semantics as AI inference rather than confirmed fact, and remains truthful/pending when Graphiti inference is absent. No new inference engine, graph store, database, sidecar, dependency, workflow, renderer or general-purpose Yance infrastructure is authorized.
